'Strangled with dupatta': Delhi woman kills husband in front of mother-in-law
description: A shocking incident unfolded in east Delhi's Rashid Market where a 20-year-old woman allegedly strangled her 19-year-old husband to death. The crime, reportedly committed in a fit of rage, occurred after the husband accused her of an extramarital affair and confiscated her phone. Despite his mother's attempts to intervene, the woman allegedly used her dupatta to commit the act. The accused has been arrested.

title: Sergey Brin sold his NYC real estate: Here's what Mamdani's rent freeze cost him
description: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has divested his stake in a New York City real estate fund for a fraction of its value, selling for just six cents on the dollar. This significant loss comes as Mayor Zohran Mamdani's rent freeze tightens conditions for landlords. The fund, A&E Real Estate, confirmed the sale, citing the challenging market for rent-stabilized apartments.
